description: bcm-pod-2.4.3-gre-v1 with the pod's 5 GHz radio as a fronthaul only: wl0 (bcm4366, 11ac) serves the 5 GHz radio's M2 set on its home AP wl0.2, its other BSSes left out (no 5 GHz backhaul slot). The profile places wl0 (spec 9): a fronthaul with no station, it gets channel 36 at 80 MHz when its slot is created, a non-DFS channel in both the US and EU sets, whatever channel the pod had; EMOSA does not move it after (a channel selection that forbids it is declined, spec 3.4). The backhaul stays on wl1 (2.4 GHz): its station and the GRE parent AP wl1.1. wl0.2 is the 5 GHz home AP as the pod's own cloud writes it (oftag home--1). The backhaul row clears a MAC list on the parent AP (mac_list_type none): a pod converted live keeps its former manager's whitelist there, which would refuse the fleet's other pods as its children.
